subject: MAP checkpoint: evaluation plan to MSA/DPA sequencing for MedTech Solutions
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Sara Barnes <sara.barnes@medtechsolutions.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Jan 2028 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: MAP draft + sequencing questions for procurement/legal

Hi Sara —

Thanks again for the demo last week. As discussed, I attached a first-pass mutual action plan (MAP_MedTech_v1.xlsx) and a short SOW outline for the pilot (SOW_outline.docx). My goal with this thread is to lock down the critical procurement/legal sequencing so we can commit to a target go/no-go by the end of February.

Key asks I have for your team:
- Can procurement confirm the preferred cadence for legal reviews (single pass vs. staggered MSA then DPA)?
- Confirm whether you need a redline of our MSA or a short highlights doc first.
- Proposed dates for a joint legal sync (30–45 minute call) — we're available next week on Thursday 1/12 or Friday 1/13 PST.

Quick notes on our side:
- We recommend parallel review of the MSA and DPA with a 1-week handoff window between drafts to avoid rework.
- For pilot billing we will use the Order Form in the SOW outline; we can generate a binding order form once the MSA template is agreed.

Attachments: MAP_MedTech_v1.xlsx, SOW_outline.docx

Thanks — look forward to confirming the sync.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
E: evelyn.hart@redwood.com | M: +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Sara Barnes <sara.barnes@medtechsolutions.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Hale <tom.hale@medtechsolutions.com>, MedTech Solutions Procurement <procurement@medtechsolutions.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Jan 2028 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP draft + sequencing questions for procurement/legal

Evelyn —

Thanks for sending these over and for the clear asks. High level from procurement/legal:
- We prefer an initial legal read where our counsel flags any fundamental commercial or data-residency issues, followed by a consolidated redline pass on the MSA. DPA can be reviewed in parallel but will likely require examples of data flows.
- We need a short DPA Q&A so our privacy team can pre-clear any patterned exceptions. I'll attach a list of preliminary questions after this note.

Tom (cc) is our procurement lead; we've tentatively blocked 1/13 10:00–10:45 PST for the legal + procurement sync but can move if that conflicts with your team.

Two items to flag:
1) We have a hard internal milestone to get contractual framework agreed by 2/22 to align with an upcoming board review.
2) Our security team will request SOC2 evidence and a short runbook of your data retention and deletion process during the pilot.

I'll follow up with a short list of DPA questions and a meeting invite.

—Sara
Sara Barnes
Director of IT Procurement | MedTech Solutions
S: sara.barnes@medtechsolutions.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Sara Barnes <sara.barnes@medtechsolutions.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Jan 2028 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP draft + sequencing questions for procurement/legal

Sara, Evelyn —

Thanks for the context, Sara. Looping in a couple of quick legal thoughts ahead of the sync so we can use the call to resolve open sequencing choices rather than surface them.

High-level recommendation from Redwood Legal:
- We can provide a short "MSA highlights" PDF that calls out non-standard commercial clauses up-front to speed your internal review. That will be easier for procurement to digest before a full redline. (Attachment: MSA_highlights.pdf)
- Recommended flow: legal read -> MSA highlights -> consolidated redline of MSA -> concurrent DPA Q&A with privacy team. This reduces iteration between counsel teams.
- If MedTech requires specific data residency guarantees beyond our standard offering, we should capture that in the Order Form as a configurable field rather than amending the MSA template.

Open items for the call:
- Which fields in the Order Form are mandatory for your procurement sign-off (billing entity, tax details, data residency checkbox)?
- Security evidence format: SOC2 report or SOC2 + penetration testing summary?

I'll join the sync on 1/13 10:00 PST. If you'd like, Karthik can prep an internal DPA Q&A doc (DPA_questions.docx) so your privacy reviewers have a short, answerable list for their initial pass.

Regards,
Marcus Lin
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

Sara —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the milestone callout. Confirming next steps after today's sync:
- 1/13 10:00–10:45 PST: Legal + Procurement sync (invite sent). Marcus will walk through MSA highlights and Karthik will cover the DPA Q&A approach.
- Marcus to send MSA_highlights.pdf and Karthik to share DPA_questions.docx by EOD 1/13.
- Redwood to update the MAP with procurement milestones and an acceptance gating checklist; new MAP version (v1.1) to be shared by 1/17.
- Target: consolidated MSA redline by 2/8; final contractual sign-off target 2/22 as requested.

If anything changes on your side, please ping me. I'll shepherd the internal review so we stay aligned with your board timeline.

Thanks,
Evelyn
